planning.strategy_planner: Produced the §1-§7 decomposition memo: storage strategy (Blob in Dexie / Option A over URL.createObjectURL and File System Access API), tagging UX (single tag per clip, scrub+1/30s frame step), playback integration (bypass Phase-5 scheduler — the <video> element IS the pre-cue delay generator; route presses through unchanged classifyRep), RT measurement (reuses recordPress without engine change via cueShownAt = clipStartedAt + clip.cueAtMs on performance.now() clock), results storage (additive RepRecord.clipId? + SessionRecord.mode? — no new SessionRecord variant; Phase-5 analytics continue to work), sub-phase decomposition (N=3 with concrete files-to-touch + acceptance criteria each), and six risks (R1-R6) flagged for red-team scrutiny.
planning.architecture_red_team: Returned 1 ACCEPTED + 8 MODIFY + 1 BLOCK. Verdict: send back to planner for tightened revision; the plan is structurally sound but several acceptance criteria as written are not falsifiable and the parallel `clipmode/runner.ts` slice duplicates `commitRep` invariants from `src/store/session.ts:107-139` in a way that directly violates the DRY gate. The BLOCK (concern 9) called out the missing §B5/§B6 cross-cuts analogous to Phase 2b's §B1-B4. Concrete required edits enumerated per concern (1-7 + 9 + 10) with quoted source lines and exact required wording.
planning.red_team_resolution: All 8 MODIFY + 1 BLOCK addressed in the `### Resolved red-team blockers — Phase 6` section appended to artifacts/decision-memo.md and reflected in docs/PHASES.md and docs/QUALITY_GATES.md. Key lock-ins: (1) commitRep() extraction in 6.3 itself (not deferred) — engine/persistence.ts becomes the single source of rep-commit invariants for both session.ts and clipmode/runner.ts; (2) exact v4 Dexie .stores() declaration enumerated + v3→v4 upgrade test required; (4) addClip() returns a typed `{ ok, reason }` result + 200MB hard cap + QuotaExceededError stub test + 250MB-blob test; (5) requestVideoFrameCallback feature gate disables Clip mode + banner on unsupported browsers — eliminates the Safari<15.4 measurement-incoherence risk; (6) segmented Live/Clip control above the existing Start button (single Start, no second button) — preserves IdleScreen affordance + inherits phone-pairing gate; (7) uniform random with replacement + no-repeat-prev distribution + a 200-draw bound test (±20% per clip); (10) 6.3 sets `project_complete: true` and the next iteration writes artifacts/project-complete.json with `final_phase: '6.3', deferred: ['phase-7']`.
